title: RNA-seq of human melanoma cell line A375 treated with the tetracycline analogs Col-3 or doxycycline against untreated controls

atlas_processing.source_statement: Expression Atlas mapped reads to Ensembl release 95 with TopHat2 2.1.1 and quantified them with HTSeq 0.6.1p1. Exact FASTA and annotation hashes remain to be pinned.
atlas_processing.diagnostic_baseline: Diagnostic OLS on log2(median-ratio-normalized counts + 1), compound only; DESeq2 confirmation remains required.

verified_resources.format_check: Every retained count parsed as a non-negative integer; repeated run columns, where present, were accepted only after full-vector equality checks.
Analysed run identifiers are present, unique and represented in the retained count matrix.
